{{Infobox auto}}

A '''pupusa''' is a stuffed flatbread that heals {{Value|Pupusa|heals}} and has no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/pupusa.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Dough, [[cheese]], [[oil]] and a [[Cooked Porkchop|cooked porkchop]] or [[Cooked Chicken|cooked chicken]] make 4. The oil's glass bottle is meant to be given back, but in 1.12.2-beta the advancement that returns it still names the recipe by an old ID, so it is used up.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref> No advancement unlocks the recipe, so it never appears in the recipe book, although the 1.10 changelog lists its unlock as fixed.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a pupusa takes {{Value|Pupusa|eat_time}} and heals {{Value|Pupusa|heals}}.
